annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that the Host header field-value be the authority component of the target URI, minus any userinfo and its '@' delimiter. This yields a clear, single implementation behavior (host:port if present, otherwise host). No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
